camera_note: Human eye height 1.60m; ceiling shown in human views. Perspective 38deg vertical (~63deg horizontal), doorway 44deg (~71deg horizontal) at 16:9. Overview/top orthographic; only roof hidden, all walls retained. No geometry moved or carved for cameras.

acceptance_scope: static closed-pod spatial blockout only; not final dimensions, ergonomics, opening sweep, mechanical design or art identity approval

visual_judgments.question: 21×9.5m比例
visual_judgments.observation: 四区与十字通道清楚，横向延展但未见明显失衡。
visual_judgments.basis: native view inspection and recorded geometry; qualitative spatial judgment

visual_judgments.question: 1.4m门到2.4m入口轴线
visual_judgments.observation: 两侧各展开0.50m，门口呈明确展开，单人进入未被舱体夹住。
visual_judgments.basis: native view inspection and recorded geometry; qualitative spatial judgment

visual_judgments.question: 门后左右舱
visual_judgments.observation: 视觉上近，后墙端余量0.50m；内侧底座距中心线各1.20m，中央轴线保持连续。
visual_judgments.basis: native view inspection and recorded geometry; qualitative spatial judgment

visual_judgments.question: 3.5m横向通道
visual_judgments.observation: 较宽敞，仍有主通道层级；未见明显过窄或宽度失衡。
visual_judgments.basis: native view inspection and recorded geometry; qualitative spatial judgment

visual_judgments.question: 0.7m舱间操作位
visual_judgments.observation: 单人静态接近可容纳，但偏紧；直径0.45m柱两侧仅各余0.125m。上下舱、转身与辅助操作仍待动作验证。
visual_judgments.basis: native view inspection and recorded geometry; qualitative spatial judgment

visual_judgments.question: 3.4m暂定净高
visual_judgments.observation: 比1m舱体高，但与1.68m尺度柱比较未见明显压低或夸张大厅化；保持P测试值。
visual_judgments.basis: native view inspection and recorded geometry; qualitative spatial judgment

visual_judgments.question: 标准化生命保存室身份
visual_judgments.observation: 低矮单层及统一分层支持标准设备感；中性灰模的重复闭舱排列仍可能带来临床或停尸间联想，最终美术辨识待后续验证。
visual_judgments.basis: native view inspection and recorded geometry; qualitative spatial judgment

visual_judgments.question: 新增实体碰撞
visual_judgments.observation: 90个原生实体正体积碰撞0，门洞真实留空；80个原舱分层形状与坐标不变。
visual_judgments.basis: native view inspection and recorded geometry; qualitative spatial judgment
